newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EBRD to buy more of Lithuanian Hermis Bank.
newsitem.headline: EBRD to buy more of Lithuanian Hermis Bank.

text.p: A leading Lithuanian bank, Hermis Bank, said on Wednesday it would boost its share capital to 67 million litas from 42.2 million litas and that the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) would buy more stock.

"Most of the new share emission will be bought by foreign investors. The EBRD will buy five million litas worth," a Hermis Bank spokesman said. The bank is already owned 60 percent by foreign investors and the EBRD has 25 percent.
The bank had a first-half profit of 10.7 million litas and assets worth 447.2 million litas. The issue is due to be completed within three months.
